title: Blackbaud and Gravyty Expand Partnership to Help Advancement Teams Build Stronger Donor Relationships and Grow Giving
summary: Blackbaud today announced an expanded strategic partnership with Gravyty, an AI-powered engagement and fundraising technology provider, to help advancement teams more easily connect the tools and data they rely on to engage supporters and grow giving.
body_markdown:
*Direct integration helps organizations connect engagement and fundraising, reduce manual work and make more of their existing technology investments*


**Charleston, S.C. (November 19, 2026)** — Blackbaud (NASDAQ: BLKB), the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, today announced an expanded strategic partnership with Gravyty, an AI-powered engagement and fundraising technology provider, to help advancement teams more easily connect the tools and data they rely on to engage supporters and grow giving.


As a Blackbaud Build Partner, Gravyty integrates directly with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT™ to help advancement teams access smarter prospect insights, automate outreach and build stronger donor relationships. For customers using Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT, Gravyty supports real-time data syncing designed to keep contact information, engagement activity and outreach data connected without manual exports. This connected experience helps customers get greater value from technology they already use while spending less time moving information between systems.


“Advancement teams need technology that works together so they can spend less time managing systems and more time building the relationships that move their institutions forward,” said Mark Davis, vice president, education products, Blackbaud. “Our partnership with Gravyty gives customers more choice and connects complementary capabilities with the Blackbaud solutions they already trust. By bringing data and workflows together, we can help advancement professionals work more efficiently, personalize engagement and ultimately create stronger experiences for their supporters.”


Through the partnership, customers can:


- **Connect engagement and fundraising data.** Gravyty supports real-time synchronization with Raiser’s Edge NXT, helping keep contact lists, engagement activity and outreach data in sync without manual exports.
- **Personalize supporter engagement.** Gravyty can use CRM fields to tailor communications and help advancement and alumni relations teams deliver more relevant outreach.
- **Reduce manual work.** Integrated workflows can eliminate duplication, automate actions and update CRM records, giving teams more time to focus on relationships.
- **Extend fundraising capabilities.** Gravyty provides digital fundraising and AI-powered capabilities spanning donor prioritization, automated outreach, alumni engagement and giving.
- **Simplify fundraising and payments.** Gravyty’s Advance is available through the Blackbaud Marketplace with an integration to Blackbaud Integrated Payments. For organizations using Raiser’s Edge NXT and Blackbaud Integrated Payments, payment and donor data can flow back into the Blackbaud system, reducing manual gift entry and reconciliation.


**More Choice, Without More Complexity**


The partnership reflects Blackbaud’s broader approach to giving customers flexibility in how they build their technology ecosystems without adding unnecessary complexity. Blackbaud has previously emphasized an open partner ecosystem as a way for education customers to combine purpose-built Blackbaud solutions with third-party technology that meets their specific needs.


Gravyty takes a similar approach. The company says its partnerships are designed around integrating with systems institutions already rely on, with the goal of creating unified workflows and better outcomes for staff and students. Its higher education platform includes tools for alumni engagement, mentoring, student engagement, digital fundraising and AI-assisted donor outreach.


“Advancement teams have a tremendous amount of information about their communities, but turning that information into meaningful engagement is where the real opportunity lies,” said Ashley Jones Lee, CFO at Gravyty. “By building on our longstanding relationship with Blackbaud, we’re making it easier for institutions to put their existing data and technology to work, using AI to personalize outreach, strengthen alumni and donor relationships, and ultimately drive greater impact for the communities they serve.”


**Practical AI for Advancement Teams**


The partnership also supports a practical approach to AI that puts customer outcomes first. Gravyty uses AI across capabilities including donor prioritization, automated outreach and conversational student support. Blackbaud’s AI strategy similarly emphasizes embedding intelligence into customer workflows to help organizations work more effectively while keeping customer data private and protected. Blackbaud does not use customer data to train its AI models.


Together, the companies are helping customers take advantage of AI-powered capabilities within a more connected technology ecosystem, giving advancement professionals more time and insight to focus on the relationships behind their mission.
